article.intro: Valkyries are the choosers of the slain in Norse myth, who carried fallen warriors to Valhalla. Their names were built from Old Norse words for battle, spears and shields. This **valkyrie name generator** builds names the same way, from real Old Norse name parts, with a title if you want one.
